**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The indemnity package in Section 20 meets the **preferred** position on every material term:

| Element | Where | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Vendor IP indemnity | 20.1 | Defence + indemnity for Customer, Affiliates and their personnel; no modification/combination/specification exclusions carved into the grant (better than fallback) |
| Breach of law / data breach / gross negligence & wilful misconduct | 20.2 | Covers all of (b)–(d) of our model language, plus bodily injury and property damage |
| Standard procedure | 20.4 | Reciprocal: prompt notice, cooperation at indemnitor's expense, control of defence, delay excusing only on material prejudice, no adverse settlement without consent |
| Infringement remedies | 20.5 | Procure / modify or replace without materially reducing functionality / terminate and refund; Vendor cannot terminate unaffected Services |
| Customer's indemnity kept narrow | 20.3 | Limited to unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorised and Customer's own breach of law, with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions |
| Cap interaction | 21.3 | Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims, so Vendor's indemnities sit outside the cap entirely — stronger than the fallback's 3× super-cap |

Section 9.3 further backs 20.5 with a Customer termination right if Vendor infringes and cannot deliver the required remedies. Nothing here falls short of the playbook, so I have submitted a compliant finding and made no edits.
